---
name: Compatibility evidence
about: Document a model and firmware without claiming untested support
title: "Compatibility: "
---

## Environment

Public model, firmware or unknown, Windows build, adapter/driver, tested commit.

## Feature results

Battery, speaker-side list, connect/disconnect, diagnostics. Mark each passed, failed or not tested. Distinguish paired, connected and active audio.

## Reproduction and evidence

Only sanitized reports. No MACs, serials, private names, raw traces or paths. State whether changes were read back. Use only devices you own or are authorized to test.
